This Product Requirements Document (PRD) defines the functional requirements, expected system behavior, and feature 
scope for KTern.AI's Agentic AI -driven License Optimization and Segregation of Duties (SoD) Analysis modules, as 
contracted with Lotte Chemi cal. 
The document is structured in two primary streams:  
o Stream 1:  License Optimization — AI-driven analysis of SAP user licenses, roles, transactions, and 
authorization objects to identify optimization opportunities and reduce costs.  
◦ The proposed pricing is applicable for 12 runs per year for a duration of 3 years.  
o Stream 2:  SoD (Segregation of Duties) Analysis — AI-powered detection of access conflicts, critical violations, 
and compliance gaps across SAP authorization landscapes.  
◦ The proposed pricing is applicable for 90 runs per year for a duration of 3 years.

2.  Need Statement  
Lotte Chemical manages a large -scale, multi -geography SAP landscape. Maintaining SAP license compliance, cost 
efficiency, and access governance at this scale using manual methods is no longer sustainable. The key pain points 
driving this initiative include : 
o No single source of truth for SAP user license consumption across business units and geographies.  
o Manual license classification requiring significant effort from SAP BASIS and Security teams.  
o Lack of real -time visibility into role usage, authorization footprints, and SoD risk exposure.  
o Inability to proactively detect compliance violations prior to audits.  
o High cost of over -licensed users who do not consume the access they are assigned.  
o No repeatable, scalable governance model for ongoing license and SoD management.  
 
KTern.AI addresses these pain points through its Agentic AI -driven License Optimization and SoD Analysis agents, 
delivering automated, continuous, and audit -ready intelligence across the SAP landscape.

3. Recommendations – Object Level Cleaning & Role Based Cleaning  
Object -Level Cleaning (Focus: Professional License Objects)  
1. Eg: Filter  “Professional License” objects only  
o Step 1: Object Traceability: Identify all roles containing the auth object (e.g., “ZX”) - (irrespective of 
used/unused)  
o Step 2: Role Assignment: For each role (e.g., F_LFA1) that contains the object:  
▪ State the number of users assigned & List the user names  
o Step 3: Usage & License Segregation: Based on trace:  
▪ Identify users who actually use the object  
▪ Classify users into:

KTern.AI  |  Product Requirements Document  —  License Optimization & SoD Analysis  
KTern.AI |  Client: Lotte Chemical  |  Page 8 ▪ High privilege (Professional required)  
▪ Lower privilege (Functional/Productive sufficient)  
o Step 4: Role Optimization:    
▪ Create a separate high -privilege role for the identified Professional users  
▪ Remove high -privilege objects from the old role (F_LFA1)  
▪ Retain only required objects for remaining users in the old role (F_LFA1)  
2. Role -Based Cleaning (Focus: Usage Efficiency)  
3. Step 1: Role Assignment Analysis: Identify all users assigned to the role  
4. Step 2: Usage Validation: Identify users who:  
o Did not use any objects in the role  
o Or have very low usage (specify it clearly)  
5. Step 3: Pattern Identification: Evaluate across users:  
o If majority unused (give count) → role is a cleanup candidate  
o If partially used (give count) → role requires optimization (object cleanup)  
6. Step 4: User -Level Cleanup: For users not using the role:  
o Identify other unused roles assigned  
o Recommend removal of unused role assignments

5.  Enhancement Ticket & SLA Policy  
Any feature or enhancement that falls outside the boundaries of the signed Statement of Work shall be submitted as an 
enhancement ticket and processed in accordance with the KTern.AI Service Level Agreement (SLA). The SLA governs all

Enhancement Ticket Process:

o KTern.AI Product team reviews and classifies the ticket by priority (P1 –P4). 
o Ticket is scheduled into the monthly product release cycle based on priority and common customer demand.  
o Customer is notified of the target release sprint and estimated delivery date.  
o Delivery is governed by the SLA timelines detailed below.

6.  License Optimization — Features & Requirements  
The License Optimization stream delivers AI -driven analysis of SAP user licenses, role assignments, authorization 
objects, and transaction usage. It enables Lotte Chemical to identify optimization opportunities, right -size license 
consumption, and reduce r ecurring SAP costs.

✓ IN SCOPE (SoW)  Covered under Statement of Work  
 
Description

profile.  
Key Data Points  
◦ User Name , User Type, Validity Date (From / To)  
◦ Status  
◦ License Type Assignment  
◦ Last Login Date and Login Frequency

⚠ Enhancement Ticket Required  Requires separate enhancement ticket per KTern.AI SLA  
 
Ticket Summary  
Introduce a new column "Target License Classification" after the Email column in the user table. This column represents the 
highest privileged license type assigned to each user.  
Classification Logic  
◦ Hierarchy: Productivity < Functional < Professional  
◦ If a user has multiple license types → assign the highest applicable  
◦ Professional always takes precedence → classify as Professional  
◦ Functional + Productivity → classify as Functional  
◦ Only Productivity → classify as Productivity  
Expected Behavior  
◦ Column appears after Email column in user table  
◦ Logic computed at backend level for consistency  
◦ Available in UI, included in export/download  
◦ Consistent across Home Page and Landing Page views  
◦ Filterable and sortable by Target License Classification  
Business Impact  
◦ Provides clear, standardized single -value license classification per user  
◦ Enables accurate license optimization and cost reduction decisions  
◦ Reduces manual consolidation effort — improves operational efficiency  
◦ Improves reporting clarity for stakeholders — better governance and audit readiness  
Priority Suggestion  
P2 — High (directly impacts License Optimization accuracy)

Ticket Summary

exported Excel/PDF report. At a minimum, basic recommendations must be visible.  
Recommendation Types  
◦ Object -Level Cleaning (Focus: Professional License Objects)  
◦ Role-Based Cleaning (Focus: Usage Efficiency)  
◦ Authorization -Based Role Optimization (Focus: Redundant Role Cleanup)

KTern.AI  |  Product Requirements Document  —  License Optimization & SoD Analysis  
KTern.AI |  Client: Lotte Chemical  |  Page 21 Recommendation 1: Object -Level Cleaning  
◦ Identify all Professional license authorization objects  
◦ Trace actual object usage per user  
◦ Classify users: Professional Required vs. Functional/Productive Sufficient  
◦ Step 1 — Object Traceability: Identify all roles containing the auth object (irrespective of 
used/unused)  
◦ Step 2 — Role Assignment: For each role containing the object, state number of users 
assigned and list user names  
◦ Step 3 — Usage & License Segregation: Identify users who actually use  the object; 
classify into High Privilege (Professional required) vs. Lower Privilege 
(Functional/Productive sufficient)  
◦ Step 4 — Role Optimization: Create a new high -privilege role for Professional users; 
remove high -privilege objects from old role; retain only required objects for remaining 
users in the old role  
Recommendation 2: Role -Based Cleaning  
◦ Identify all roles assigned to users  
◦ Step 1 — Role Assignment Analysis: Identify all users assigned to the role  
◦ Step 2 — Usage Validation: Identify users who did not use any objects in the role or have 
very low usage  
◦ Step 3 — Pattern Identification: If majority unused → role is cleanup candidate; if partially 
used → role requires optimization (object cleanup)  
◦ Step 4 — User -Level Cleanup: Recommend removal of unused role assignments for 
users not using the role  
Recommendation 3: Authorization -Based Role Optimization  
◦ Identify authorization objects present across multiple roles  
◦ Detect object overlap across roles  
◦ Logic: If object exists in multiple roles → do not mark all roles as used by that object 
alone  
◦ If role has only redundant objects OR only unused objects → recommend role removal  
◦ If role has at least one unique used object → retain role  
◦ Example: User has Role A (O1 + unused objects) and Role B (O1 only). O1 is used → 
Remove Role A as O1 is covered by Role B  
Dashboard Behavior  
◦ Recommendations panel/section on Home Page and Landing Page  
◦ Each recommendation includes: User/Role, Recommendation Type, Recommended 
Action, Justification  
◦ Filterable by recommendation type and severity

Term  Definition  
Authorization Object  An SAP security element that controls access to business functions, fields, and activities within the system.  
Enhancement Ticket  A formal request for a feature or change that is outside the signed SoW, processed under the KTern.AI SLA.  
Firefighter Access  Emergency privileged access in SAP, typically managed via SAP GRC firefighter IDs for break -glass scenarios.  
License 
Classification  The categorization of an SAP user's license type (Professional / Functional / Productivity) based on their access and 
usage patterns.  
OTC Order -to-Cash — the end -to-end business process from customer order creation through billing and cash collection.  
PRD Product Requirements Document — this document.  
Role Utilization  The degree to which authorization objects and transactions within an assigned role are actively used by the assigned 
user.  
SLA Service Level Agreement — the KTern.AI policy governing support response times and enhancement ticket delivery.  
SoD Segregation of Duties — the principle of separating conflicting business process steps across different users to reduce 
fraud and error risk.  
SoW Statement of Work — the signed contractual document between KTern.AI and Lotte Chemical defining the scope of 
delivery.  
T-Code  Transaction Code — an SAP shortcut that executes a specific SAP function or program.  
USMM / LAW  SAP License Administration Workbench and User System Measurement — SAP tools for license measurement 
and compliance.
